correctness.rationale: Affine F7 support normalization reduces all five-element supports to R={2,3,4,5,6}; modulation shifts a zero to (0,0). Every possible five-zero set therefore appears among C(48,4)=194580 origin-containing five-row matrices over Q(zeta7). Independently implemented exact cyclotomic determinant/cofactor algorithm enumerated all 194580: 185895 nonsingular mod29, 3225 extra nonsingular over Q(zeta7), 5415 rank-four singular (5085 forcing a coefficient zero, 330 full-support one-dimensional kernels), and 45 rank-three cases each with an essential column forcing zero. Each of 330 surviving kernel rays has exactly the selected five zeros. One witness supplies existence. Pair double counting gives 49*330/5=3234; degree-2 polynomial rigidity makes quadratic-linear character action on each five-supported ray free of orbit size 49, hence 66 orbits. Full finite census is exhaustive and exact; not a floating point sample.
